identity.name: Foot & Ankle International
identity.source_note: Live guide is blocked to automated fetch (SAGE Cloudflare). source_hash is the SHA-256 of the normalized RAW Internet Archive snapshot of the official guide (web.archive.org/web/20250718144957id_/https://journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/fai, captured 2025-07-18) and is reproducible. Rules were encoded from the official SAGE-hosted FAI Submission Guidelines PDF (content consistent with this snapshot). Session C's freshness cron must use a headless fetch to re-verify the live page.

encoding_notes: Rules extracted from the official SAGE-hosted 'FAI Submission Guidelines' PDF (us.sagepub.com/.../49175_FAI_Submission_Guidelines.pdf); the canonical journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/fai page is Cloudflare-protected and unreadable to curl/WebFetch (see identity.source_note). source_hash is therefore of the page shell, not the rule text.

layout: TEXT rule = '12-point font double-spaced in a clean and legible font (Times New Roman, Arial, etc)'. Times New Roman 12 recorded (first-listed acceptable font; other clean fonts are also permitted). Margins 1.25" sides (31.75 mm) and 0.5" top/bottom (12.7 mm). page_size = null (inch margins imply US Letter but the guide does not state it).

layout.headings: 'Main headings are bold upper-case' -> level 1 (upper, bold). 'Subheadings are simply bold' -> level 2 (bold, case as_is, since case is unspecified). The guide also says manuscript titles are bold+underlined, but the schema heading model has no underline attribute.

line_numbers = 'continuous' ('All lines of manuscript must be consecutively numbered using your software's Line Number feature'). page_numbers.show and running_head.show = false: the guide states the title need not be in a header and gives no page-number/running-head requirement.

title_page.elements = ['article_title'] only: FAI uses no separate manuscript title page (the title 'does not need to be on its own page'); author names, affiliations, degrees and the corresponding author are supplied via the required cover letter and the ScholarOne submission screens, not the manuscript body. authors_degrees = 'include' ('Authors may list up to 2 academic degrees after their names').

abstract: structured with Background/Methods/Results/Conclusion; a fifth section 'Clinical Relevance' is added for basic-science articles (not encoded as a fixed section). ~250-300 words (max_words = 300); the SAGE Track abstract field itself caps at 250 words but the full abstract up to ~300 words goes in the manuscript body. Abstracts are NOT required for case reports or clinical tips (hence null abstract_max_words for those types).
keywords: required; 'first letter of each word capitalized' -> case = 'title'; 'listed using semicolons' -> separator = 'semicolon'. Min/max keyword count not stated (null).

references.style = 'custom': FAI numbers references but lists them ALPHABETICALLY (not in citation order), uses a distinctive author format ('Ostrum, RF; Meo, PD; Subramanian, R:' -- semicolon-separated, colon before title) and NLM journal abbreviations, with DOI appended when available. This alphabetical-numbered + superscript hybrid matches neither standard AMA nor Vancouver, so 'custom' is used with order = 'alphabetical'.

references.in_text = 'superscript' and in_text_punctuation = 'after' ('Citations must be superscript and come directly AFTER punctuation'). NOTE: in-text FIGURE callouts are the opposite -- spelled out and placed BEFORE punctuation, e.g. '(Figure 1)' -- captured via figures.callout_style = 'Figure'.

references.et_al_threshold = 5 captures 'list all authors when <=5'; the guide's actual rule is that with MORE than five authors you list only the first three then 'et al.' (i.e. >5 -> first 3 + et al), which the single-threshold field cannot express exactly. include_doi = true ('If an article has a DOI link associated with it, include it after the reference'). max_count and per-type reference min/max are not stated (null).

No manuscript word limits, reference-count limits, or figure/table-count limits are stated anywhere in the guide -> all such fields null. The guide gives extensive numeric/percentage/units house-style rules that are copy-editing (not structural formatting) and are not schema fields.

figures: 'upload each figure or table individually' -> separate_files = true. Accepted formats TIFF/JPG/Postscript -> tif,tiff,jpg,jpeg,eps. Resolution 'must be at least 300 dpi or higher'. Figure/table legends go in a Legends section -> legends_location = 'figure_legends_section'. callout_style = 'Figure' (spelled out).

tables.placement = 'separate_file' (tables uploaded individually alongside figures). caption_position and numbering left null: table legends live in the Legends section with no stated above/below position, and no table numbering scheme (arabic/roman) is specified (figures are labeled 'Fig. 1', 'Fig. 2A').

declarations: Conflict of Interest disclosure is mandatory (author selects one of four COI statements) and a funding statement is mandatory (one of two financial-support statements); both are printed on the article's first page. Informed consent AND institutional review board (IRB) approval statements are required for human-subjects studies (patient_consent + ethics_approval) -- encoded as required with this human-subjects caveat.

blinding: FAI states manuscripts go to 'blind peer review' (single-blind implied); it does NOT require a separate anonymized title page, author-identifier scrubbing in the body, or docx metadata scrubbing -- author identity is handled via the cover letter/ScholarOne, so all blinding flags except none are false.
misc.cover_letter_required = true ('All submissions to FAI must include a cover letter'). highlights_required and title_case left null (not addressed). orcid_required = false (ORCID not mentioned).

article_types encoded: original_research (full IMRaD structure), case_report ('Introduction, Case Report, Discussion, and Summary/Conclusion'; abstract not required; assigned Level V; very few accepted), and technical_note mapped from FAI 'Clinical Tips' (Introduction/Discussion section + Technique section; assigned Level V). Review types are not detailed in this guide and are not encoded.

Session-A consolidation (2026-07-09): supersedes any earlier note in this list that describes source_hash as a bot-challenge 'shell' hash or that records a placeholder body font/line-spacing. Authoritative current state: source_hash is reproducible per identity.source_note; font family/size and line-spacing are null wherever the live guide is silent, so the engine preserves the author's value rather than imposing a guess.
